```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Figure 6
### Local
```{r}
raw = read.csv("Data/raw_data.csv")
```

```{r}
set_horizon = 0
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
plot_data <- raw %>%
  filter(output_type == "quantile") %>%
  mutate(
    output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
    date = as.Date(target_end_date)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = output_type_id,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "q_"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    observed = oracle_value,
    predicted_value = `q_0.5`,  
    lower = `q_0.025`,           
    upper = `q_0.975`            
  ) |> filter(model_id == "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean") |> filter(horizon == set_horizon) 

plot_data$location = factor(plot_data$location)
```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=10}
obsvspred_loc <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = "Prediction Interval"),
              alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted_value, color = "Predicted HSA"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = observed, color = "Observed HSA"),
             size = 2, shape = 16) +
  facet_wrap(~location, nrow=10) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Observed HSA" = "#E74C3C",
      "Predicted HSA" = "#F39C12"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Prediction Interval" = "#F39C12")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent Influenza ED Visits"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
  ) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 months", date_labels = "%b") 
```



### State
```{r}
raw_state = read.csv("Data/state_raw.csv")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
plot_data_state <- raw_state %>%
  filter(output_type == "quantile") %>%
  mutate(
    output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
    date = as.Date(target_end_date)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = output_type_id,
    values_from = state_value,
    names_prefix = "q_"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    observed = oracle_value,
    predicted_value = `q_0.5`,  
    lower = `q_0.025`,           
    upper = `q_0.975`            
  ) |> filter(model_id == "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean") |> filter(horizon == set_horizon) 

plot_data_state$location = factor(plot_data_state$location)
```

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=10}
obsvspred_state <- ggplot(plot_data_state, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = "Prediction Interval"),
              alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted_value, color = "Predicted HSA"),
            linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = observed, color = "Observed HSA"),
             size = 2, shape = 16) +
  facet_wrap(~location, nrow=10) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Observed HSA" = "#E74C3C",
      "Predicted HSA" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Prediction Interval" = "darkgray")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent Influenza ED Visits"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
  ) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 months", date_labels = "%b") 
```

```{r}
plot_data$level <- "Local"
plot_data_state$level <- "State"

combined <- bind_rows(
  plot_data       %>% select(date, location, level, observed, predicted_value, lower, upper),
  plot_data_state %>% select(date, location, level, observed, predicted_value, lower, upper)
)

combined$level <- factor(combined$level, levels = c("Local", "State"))
combined$location <- factor(combined$location)

combined = combined |> filter(!(location %in% c("texas", "colorado", "georgia", "indiana" , "maine", "nyc", "utah", "virginia", "south-carolina", "maryland", "massachusetts", "minnesota", "north-carolina", "oregon")))
```

```{r}
locations_per_page <- 10

n_pages_combined <- n_pages(
  ggplot(combined, aes(x = date)) +
    facet_grid_paginate(location ~ level, nrow = locations_per_page, ncol = 2, page = 1)
)
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=20}
for (p in seq_len(n_pages_combined)) {
  print(
    ggplot(combined, aes(x = date)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = level),
                  alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
      geom_line(aes(y = predicted_value, color = paste(level, "Predicted")), linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(aes(y = observed, color = paste(level, "Observed")), size = 2, shape = 16) +
      facet_grid_paginate(location ~ level, nrow = locations_per_page, ncol = 2, page = p) +
      scale_color_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
          "Local Observed"  = "#E74C3C",
          "Local Predicted" = "#F39C12",
          "State Observed"  = "#E74C3C",
          "State Predicted" = "black"
        )
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        name = NULL,
        values = c(
          "Local" = "#F39C12",
          "State" = "darkgray"
        )
      ) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent Influenza ED Visits") +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        text            = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title      = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title    = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "left"
      ) + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 months", date_labels = "%b")
  )
}
```
